config_keys.policies_root: REQUIRED str - the OTHER root (coop3) holding the read-only checkpoints
config_keys.checkpoint_k: REQUIRED int >= 0 - the ONE pinned k for both arms (default for k_B/k_R)
config_keys.checkpoint_k_B / checkpoint_k_R: optional per-arm override; MUST agree, mismatch refuses
config_keys.checkpoint_sha256: REQUIRED {'B': hex64, 'R': hex64} - sha256 of coop3's B_checkpoint_<k>.pt / R_checkpoint_<k>.pt; mismatch refuses BEFORE any charge
config_keys.charge_route: REQUIRED dict {run_root, q_host, q_control, q_python, q_pythonpath} (+ optional 'phases' list; default ['sumo_verification','bank_verification_ext']) - the cpuQ RPC binding the path charges through
config_keys.collect_id_prefix: REQUIRED str [a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40} - episode ids <prefix>_<arm>_k<k:03>_e<n:05d>_<seed>; never the historical hard-coded id
config_keys.episode_phase: REQUIRED str - the route phase episodes are charged in (must be registered on the route)
config_keys.runtime / accel_bounds / gpu_deadline /: REQUIRED - episode plant binding (as in every collector)
config_keys.broker: REQUIRED for arm B - single-slot config {amendment_sha256, gpu_deadline, workers:[{endpoint:{slot,destination,port,identity_file,known_hosts}, owner:{boot_id,pid,start_ticks}}]}; exactly ONE worker
config_keys.variety: optional - the registered variety_* keys (variety.split_config validates; families False/absent = legacy bytes)

what_it_does.pinned: pinned_checkpoints/pinned_policy load B_checkpoint_<k>.pt / R_checkpoint_<k>.pt from policies_root, sha256-checked against the staged config, payload update must equal k; k_B != k_R refuses; the collection root never stores or updates a policy
what_it_does.ledger_split: route_charges() probes the EXISTING cpuS->cpuQ RPC route with a read-only 'budget' op and refuses the whole path when unavailable; charges go through cpus_checking.install_remote_accounting (accel_storage.reserve routed to cpuQ's UNCHANGED reserve) with phases sumo_verification (window verifications), bank_verification_ext (confirmations) and the registered episode_phase; refuse_local_ledger guards the collection root against a second CHARGES.jsonl (file OR dir) at startup and after every round
what_it_does.rpc_route: cpus_rpc.op_reserve gains an ADDITIVE binding key 'collect' {phases, id_prefixes}: registered collection ids (route_prefixes = [<prefix>_, sv_<prefix>_, confirm_replication_sv_<prefix>_, confirm_extended_sv_<prefix>_, confirm_solo_sv_<prefix>_]) charge the SAME cpuQ ledger in the registered phases without consuming the all8 delegate allowance; without the key the binding stays all8-only with byte-identical refusal texts (tested)
what_it_does.arm_b: collector_guide queues WM-search requests (root/requests) carrying search_config = the registered it2_K2 boundary config PLUS the variety keys, so the GPU side re-derives the same additive decision groups and takes exactly floor(variety_structured_share * population) structured slots (mppi_search; byte-covered by test_variety_cpu SearchIntegration)
what_it_does.arm_r: collector_guide queues centre-only requests (no WM scoring); rb.candidates_for draws sv.random_candidates with the snapshot meta's variety_config - each draw is Bernoulli(variety_structured_share) structured vs free (share 0.25 registered), identical registered keys as B
what_it_does.broker_config_only: stage_broker writes THREE artifacts into <root>/broker and starts NOTHING: BROKER_CONFIG.json (the validated single-slot config; on cpuS the operator installs it as <root>/LS_ENDPOINTS.json next to LS_RECOVERY_CONFIG.json - the exact shape ls_broker.run consumes), STARTUP_GATES.json (the four warm_service.ADOPTABLE gate receipts that must be present with pass_ true before the slot is served), STAGE_WORKER.py (the generated worker staging script; '--check' prints readiness only, the real run is the operator's explicit action on the GPU host)
what_it_does.ids: job_id() = <collect_id_prefix>_<arm>_k<k:03>_e<n:05d>_<seed>; the root name is the argv of the module; 'lscollect1' appears nowhere in varcollect.py (tested); ls_collection.supervise gains the additive episode_prefix key (default 'lscollect1_B3' = the historical bytes, used at both its construction sites)

preflight_operator: 1. Stage this commit's source as the cpuS pytools overlay (same git-archive flow as cpuS checking; includes the plan-variety sources the GPU overlay needs).

2. cpuQ control dir: extend RPC_BINDING.json ADDITIVELY with collect = {phases: [...], id_prefixes: varcollect.route_prefixes(config)}. Default phases = ['sumo_verification','bank_verification_ext']. To charge episodes 'train' instead, add 'train' to BOTH this list and the config's episode_phase. cpus_rpc runs one short process per call, so the next call reads the new binding; without the key nothing changes.

3. Create the NEW collection root (its NAME is a parameter) and write VARCOLLECT_CONFIG.json (validated by varcollect.split_config: unknown keys refuse). checkpoint_sha256 = sha256 of coop3's B_checkpoint_003.pt / R_checkpoint_003.pt; charge_route.run_root = the ONE shared cpuQ run root.
4. Arm R: nice -n19 python -B -m tools.coopmwm.varcollect <root> --arm R (no broker needed; refuses immediately if the route is unavailable or the pinned k/sha mismatch).

5. Arm B: python -m tools.coopmwm.varcollect <root> --arm B stages the broker artifacts, then the OPERATOR (a) installs broker/BROKER_CONFIG.json as <root>/LS_ENDPOINTS.json + writes LS_RECOVERY_CONFIG.json (run_root=<root>, gpu_deadline, amendment_sha256, receipt_suffix), (b) stages/starts the ONE new GPU worker on the GPU host with broker/STAGE_WORKER.py (its four STARTUP_* gate receipts present, pass_ true), (c) starts tools.coopmwm.ls_broker <root> on cpuS. THIS BUILD ssh'es and starts nothing.

6. Verify charges remotely: cpuQ CHARGES.jsonl rows (ids carry <prefix>_ / sv_<prefix>_ / confirm_*_sv_<prefix>_) and <control>/CHARGES_RPC.jsonl rows with route='collect'; the collection root must contain NO CHARGES.jsonl.
how_to_run.stop: MAIN_STOP.json in the collection root stops the loop after the current round; budget-blocked statuses stop the rounds (charges retained, never retried blindly).
